issues.legal_issue: A refund order cannot be sustained where the finding that possession of the leased mining area was not delivered was not supported by a specific pleading or adequately considered material.
The effect of a tender condition requiring bidders to inspect and satisfy themselves about the mining area must be considered when deciding a claim for refund.
The area, if any, falling within the disputed inter-state territory must be determined when adjudicating the refund claim.
The amount actually deposited must be determined before granting a refund.
The impugned orders required setting aside and the writ petition required fresh adjudication because the High Court had not properly addressed the issues raised before it.
